reviews.text: Terry does great work. SmartWire Solutions has literally done all my electrical work. From wiring my entire basement during renovations to hanging a ceiling fan on my 17ft ceiling.

Perfection! Terry designed and installed a high-end full security system without the high-end cost. Added power sources where there were none while concealing all of the wiring. A job very well done. I look forward to the next job. Thanks!
It's seldom you meet a contractor who's knowledgeable, efficient and who cares! Terry is exactly that! Great Work! Even Greater Person!
Very professional, fast, simply and not stressful.

secondary_recommendations_archived.text: Experienced and knowledgeable, prompt and hard working. Terry Henry @ SmartWire Solutions LLC can fix your electrical problem when all other can't!
Terry has great work ethics, integrity, and gives great customer service. I have known him for 10+ years, and he is the only electrician I would hire, or recommend.

Over the last ten years I have hired Terry for any and all electrical needs. He has done everything from rewiring houses to trouble shooting small electrical problems. I have found him to be fast accurate and very fair with his pricing.
